profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.jobTitle: Senior Principal Software Engineer - Embedded Systems
profile.summary: Highly skilled Level 4 Senior Principal Software Engineer with M.S. in Computer Science and versatile experience in software development who keeps quality first, takes ownership of results, improves and simplifies processes, strives to always be learning, and coaches others as a high performing team-player.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer - Embedded Systems
positions.description:
Highlights:
• Played major developer role extending an internally built, object-oriented Python test-orchestration platform for distributed, multi-machine testing with on-demand cloud provisioning (IaC). Now used company-wide; we were recognized with a company-wide Innovation of the Year Award (team of 6).
• Extended the platform's core parser/instruction set (syntax, engine defects) and built reusable plugins, including a UDP-based test driver for hundreds of ground-control commands. Also extended the JavaScript front end with an expandable-folder test browser, redesigned execution from a stack to a FIFO queue, and served as SME/ambassador to a partner team.
• Re-architected a C++ SNMP implementation (virtual inheritance, polymorphism) for multi-platform, multi-device support and configurable auth/encryption (30+ files refactored), then authored 40 Google Test unit tests, raising coverage from ~20% to over 95%.
• Directed a team of 4 that raised safety-critical unit-test coverage from 30% to 90% in under two weeks, while representing our broader team of 12 in leadership meetings and directing technical work in the team lead's absence.
• Co-designed the initial baseline of a core embedded C++ service with Google Test coverage, and refactored core modules' OOD architecture — reducing code complexity by hundreds of lines and resolving 3+ defects (Bravo Award).
• Built the first automated integration tests for an autonomous UAV's mission computer and ground-control station, covering a full pre-takeoff-to-landing simulation and saving hundreds of QA hours per cycle.
• Debugged a dual-platform embedded C codebase (10,000s of lines; Windows simulation and vxWorks/RTOS hardware), integrating new functionality into fixed-frequency run loops (1–100 Hz) with correct endianness handling for cross-platform packing.
• Advised engineers across multiple teams on C++ best practices, algorithm design, and system architecture, raising code quality and reducing troubleshooting time.

positions.title: Pixtronix Engineering Intern - Next Gen Display Design and Verification
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Next generation display controller design; FPGA prototyping and digital verification; various verification, prototyping and design tasks in C, Verilog, and System Verilog
• Worked with Xilinx FPGA designs, MIPI, SLVS, Embedded ARM processors, Digital Image processing, Pixtronix DMS displays.
positions.insights: Debugging, Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) and +9 skills

positions.title: Systems Analyst Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Researched HTML, SQL, VBScript, & JavaScript in order to construct Web pages.
• Built lookup tools on the company web page to search database for specific information and to find inconsistencies in the system based on search results.
• Converted all department web pages from basic HTML to Microsoft Sharepoint.
• Studied manufacturing process in depth and wrote reports on all aspects of the process pertaining to business & technology.
